name: Acid Arp
description: The saw through a filter near singing, each sixteenth plucking it, up and down the chord: an acid arpeggio.

name: Bubble Arp
description: The square with the sub, through a resonant filter that each step plucks, arpeggiated up and down in sixteenths over the keys held.

name: Down Arp
description: The square and the sub through a resonant filter, the chord held played down in eighths: a falling arpeggio.

name: Fast Arp
description: The saw plucked short, the chord held played up in thirty-second notes: a fast, glittering arpeggio.

name: Soft Arp
description: A wide pulse through a dark filter, soft and round, the chord held played up in sixteenth triplets: a gentle arpeggio.

name: Triplet Arp
description: A narrow pulse two octaves up from the keys, plucked short, climbing the chord held in eighth-note triplets.

name: Acid Squelch
description: A bare saw through a resonant filter that the envelope snaps open, gliding under auto portamento into a note struck before the last one is let go, without striking the envelope again: the squelching line the instrument is known for, from a step-pattern clip with slides.

name: Deep Sub
description: The sub two octaves down under a quiet square, the filter nearly shut: a deep, felt sub.

name: Envelope Width Bass
description: The pulse's width narrowed by the envelope at each key and widening as it falls: a bass whose tone changes inside every note.

name: Funk Bass
description: The saw through a resonant filter the envelope sweeps down at each key: a quacking funk bass.

name: Gate Bass
description: The amplifier by the gate, full while a key is held and shut at once, the filter steady: an organ-like bass with no envelope on its level.

name: Glide Bass
description: The saw and the sub with portamento always on, so every note slides from the last: a sliding bass.

name: Narrow Sub Bass
description: The sub-oscillator's narrow pulse under the saw: a nasal, reedy bass.

name: Noise Pick Bass
description: The saw and the sub with a breath of noise in the strike, the envelope quick: a bass with a pick's click.

name: Pluck Bass
description: The saw and the sub an octave down through a filter the envelope plucks, a short glide between notes held together: a bass for lines of octaves, rests and slides from a step-pattern clip.

name: PWM Bass
description: The pulse's width swung by the LFO with the sub under it: a bass that churns as it holds.

name: Rubber Bass
description: The saw and the square an octave down, the filter popping open with a little resonance at each key and settling: the round, rubbery bass of the instrument.

name: Saw Punch
description: The saw and the sub, the filter snapped open at each key and falling back fast: a plain, punchy saw bass.

name: Square Bass
description: The square with the sub an octave down, the filter half shut and lifted a little at each key: a hollow, woody bass.

name: Sub Bass
description: The square and the sub-oscillator an octave under it, two octaves down, through a filter low enough to round them off: a deep, steady bass that holds as long as the key.

name: Thump Bass
description: The square and the sub through a nearly closed filter that the envelope flicks once: a short, dark thump.

name: Wobble Bass
description: The LFO's triangle sweeping the resonant filter a few times a beat: a wobbling bass.

name: Filter Kick
description: The filter singing at full resonance with a breath of noise, swept down from high by a fast envelope: a kick from the filter alone.

name: Noise Hat
description: The noise alone through an open filter, gone in a blink: a closed hat.

name: Noise Snare
description: The noise alone through a half-open filter, struck and fading in a fifth of a second: a snare from the noise source.

name: Sub Tom
description: The square and the sub through a filter the envelope flicks open, short: a round, tuned tom.

name: Blips
description: A narrow pulse at two feet through a resonant filter, the envelope over in a blink: short blips for sequences and accents.

name: Gated Pulse
description: The envelope struck by the LFO rather than the keys, a short pluck on each of its cycles while a key is held: a pulsing, rhythmic tone.

name: Laser Zap
description: No oscillator at all: the filter singing by itself, swept down from the top by a fast envelope at each key.

name: Noise Sweep
description: The noise through a resonant filter the LFO sweeps slowly up and down: wind.

name: Random Bleeps
description: The LFO's random level steps the pitch and opens the envelope at each of its cycles while a key is held: the burbling computer sound of the instrument's sample and hold.

name: Siren
description: The LFO's triangle swinging the pitch slowly and far: a wailing siren.

name: Glide Lead
description: The saw and a pulse with portamento always on, a long slide between every note: a lead for slow lines.

name: Octave Lead
description: The saw at 4' with the sub an octave under it, so every note is doubled: a bright lead in octaves.

name: Pulse Lead
description: A narrow pulse, the filter open: a thin, reedy lead that cuts.

name: Resonant Lead
description: The saw through a filter near singing that follows the keys: a lead with a nasal, vocal ring.

name: Saw Lead
description: The saw alone through an open filter that follows the keys, a little resonance: the plain synth lead.

name: Solo Lead
description: The saw and a pulse that the LFO widens and narrows, a gentle vibrato, and portamento between keys held together: a singing lead.

name: Square Lead
description: The square with the sub an octave down, a gentle vibrato: a hollow, clarinet-like lead.

name: Trill Lead
description: The LFO's square on the pitch, up a step and back several times a second: a trilling lead.

name: Wah Lead
description: The saw through a resonant filter the envelope throws open and lets fall at each note: a lead that says wah.

name: Whistle Lead
description: No oscillator: the filter singing by itself at full resonance, following the keys, a breath of noise starting it: a pure, whistled line.

name: PWM Pad
description: The pulse widened and narrowed by a slow LFO with the saw and the sub under it, a slow attack and a long release: as near a pad as one oscillator comes.

name: Slow Pad
description: The saw, a pulse the LFO widens and the sub, slow in and slow out under a soft filter: a one-voice pad for long notes.

name: Muted Pluck
description: The square under a nearly closed filter, flicked open for an instant: a muted, damped pluck.

name: Pluck
description: The saw and a pulse, the filter snapped open and falling to nothing: a short, bright pluck.

name: Resonant Pluck
description: The saw through a filter near singing, swept down fast at each key: a chirping pluck.
